description: Tanzania - Region & District Boundary is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Boundaries", published or maintained by Naichen Zhao (World Bank Group). The datasets are curated from the Tanzania National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) 2012 Population and Housing Census (PHC) of Tanzania which was preceded by the preparatory geographic work, which involved field visiting of all regions, districts, wards/shehia, villages/mitaa, localities and sub-villages in the country, primarily to create and delineate Enumeration Area boundaries (EAs) so as ... Coverage: Tanzania. It has 4 files in GeoJSON, SHP ZIP. The portal files it under Boundaries. The portal gives 2013 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
